name: Git Workbench
description: Keep Git in the PI-Desktop work panel: review changed files, stage or discard them, write or let the model generate the commit message, then commit, pull and push — plus a commit history at the bottom of the panel with the properties, changed files and diff of any commit, without leaving the app.

en.name: Git Workbench
en.description: Keep Git in the PI-Desktop work panel: review changed files, stage or discard them, write or let the model generate the commit message, then commit, pull and push — plus a commit history at the bottom of the panel with the properties, changed files and diff of any commit, without leaving the app.
en.safetyNotes: Runs the system git binary against the repository root resolved from the open workspace, always with an argument array (no shell) and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0. Commit messages are written over stdin. The one-shot completion only receives the diff of the changes being committed, not the chat transcript, and never receives credentials. Push and pull use the user's existing git remote and credentials. Before a push the plugin may read the SSH host keys of the remote with ssh-keyscan/ssh-keygen and, only after the user confirms the displayed SHA256 fingerprints, append exactly those keys to ~/.ssh/known_hosts (0600, directory 0700). It never reads private keys and changes no other file under ~/.ssh.

zh-CN.name: Git Workbench
zh-CN.description: 模型读你本次改动，自动写出规范的提交信息：在 PI-Desktop 右侧工作面板查看改动文件、按文件暂存或放弃，点一下就让模型根据 diff 生成 commit message（也可以自己手写），再提交、拉取、推送；面板底部还能查看提交历史与单个提交的属性、改动文件和差异，全程不用离开应用。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 针对从当前工作区解析出的仓库根目录调用系统 git 二进制，始终使用参数数组（不经 shell），并设置 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0；提交信息通过标准输入写入。一次性补全只收到本次要提交的改动 diff，不会收到聊天记录，也永远拿不到凭据。推送与拉取沿用你现有的 git 远端与凭据。推送前插件可能用 ssh-keyscan/ssh-keygen 读取远端的主机密钥，并且只在你确认页面上显示的 SHA256 指纹之后，才把这些密钥追加到 ~/.ssh/known_hosts（文件 0600、目录 0700）。它从不读取私钥，也不改动 ~/.ssh 下的其他文件。
